headword: {衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}
gloss: member of the House of Representatives

definitions.gloss: member of the House of Representatives
definitions.explanation: An elected member of the House of Representatives ({衆議院|しゅうぎいん}), the lower house of the Japanese National Diet. Members serve four-year terms and are chosen through a combination of single-seat constituencies and proportional representation.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}に{当選|とうせん}した。
examples.english: He was elected as a member of the House of Representatives.

examples.japanese: {衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}の{任期|にんき}は{四年|よねん}だが、{解散|かいさん}で{短|みじか}くなることもある。
examples.english: The term of a House of Representatives member is four years, but it can be shortened by dissolution.

examples.japanese: {現在|げんざい}の{衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}の{定数|ていすう}は465{人|にん}で、{小選挙区|しょうせんきょく}と{比例代表|ひれいだいひょう}から{選|えら}ばれる。
examples.english: The current fixed number of House of Representatives members is 465, elected from single-seat constituencies and proportional representation.

notes:
Combines {衆議院|しゅうぎいん} (House of Representatives) and {議員|ぎいん} (legislator, member of parliament). The {衆議院|しゅうぎいん} is the lower and more powerful house of the {国会|こっかい} (National Diet). Often abbreviated to {衆院議員|しゅういんぎいん} in news headlines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}{選挙|せんきょ}: House of Representatives election
- {衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}に{立候補|りっこうほ}する: to run for the House of Representatives
- {衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}を{務|つと}める: to serve as a member of the House of Representatives
- {前|まえ}{衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}: former House of Representatives member

RELATED WORDS:
- {参議院議員|さんぎいんぎいん}: member of the House of Councillors — the upper house counterpart
- {国会議員|こっかいぎいん}: Diet member — the broader term covering both houses
- {衆議院|しゅうぎいん}: House of Representatives — the institution itself
